title: Fare-Size Allowance on Toll Returns, Wayfare Rides
content:
**Allowance schedule.** A detour toll return on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** carries a fare-size allowance that follows the trip's fare charge amount, as booked.

| Fare charge amount | Fare-size allowance (in dollars) |
|---|---|
| $50.00 or more (large allowance fare) | $0.40 (large fare-size allowance) |
| at least $25.00 (mid allowance fare), below $50.00 | $0.20 (mid fare-size allowance) |
| below $25.00 | nothing |

A fare charge of at least $50.00 adds the large fare-size allowance of $0.40; one of at least $25.00 but below $50.00 adds the mid fare-size allowance of $0.20; a smaller fare charge adds nothing. The allowance is a dollar amount, not a share or a multiplier.

## Threshold pairs (hypothetical fare charges)

- $24.99: nothing. $25.00: $0.20.
- $49.99: $0.20. $50.00: $0.40.
